instruction: Create net namespace and run ip link
output: unshare --net bash -c 'ip link; echo "no lo yet"; ip link set lo up; ip addr add 127.0.0.1/8 dev lo'

instruction: Create veth pair between namespaces
output: ip link add veth0 type veth peer name veth1

instruction: Move veth into namespace
output: ip link set veth1 netns NS_NAME

instruction: Set up bridge and attach namespace
output: ip link add br0 type bridge; ip link set veth0 master br0; ip link set br0 up

instruction: Run DHCP client in net namespace
output: nsenter -n -t PID dhclient eth0

instruction: Use iptables in network namespace
output: nsenter -n -t PID iptables -L

instruction: Check network interfaces inside namespace
output: nsenter -n -t PID ip addr

instruction: Ping from inside a network namespace
output: nsenter -n -t PID ping 8.8.8.8

instruction: Create named network namespace with ip netns
output: ip netns add blue

instruction: List named network namespaces
output: ip netns list

instruction: Execute command in named network namespace
output: ip netns exec blue ip addr

instruction: Delete a named network namespace
output: ip netns delete blue

instruction: Connect two net namespaces with veth
output: ip netns add ns1 && ip netns add ns2 && ip link add veth1 type veth peer name veth2 && ip link set veth1 netns ns1 && ip link set veth2 netns ns2

instruction: Assign IP to veth in namespace
output: ip netns exec ns1 ip addr add 10.0.0.1/24 dev veth1 && ip netns exec ns1 ip link set veth1 up

instruction: Ping between two net namespaces
output: ip netns exec ns1 ping -c 2 10.0.0.2

instruction: Add default route in net namespace
output: ip netns exec ns1 ip route add default via 10.0.0.254

instruction: Add NAT masquerade for namespace traffic
output: iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 10.0.0.0/24 -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE

instruction: Enable IP forwarding for namespace
output: echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward

instruction: Create macvlan in namespace
output: ip link add macvlan0 link eth0 type macvlan mode bridge; ip link set macvlan0 netns ns1

instruction: Create ipvlan in namespace
output: ip link add ipvlan0 link eth0 type ipvlan mode l2; ip link set ipvlan0 netns ns1

instruction: Run iperf in namespace for net perf
output: ip netns exec ns1 iperf3 -s &; ip netns exec ns2 iperf3 -c 10.0.0.1

instruction: Check route table inside namespace
output: ip netns exec ns1 ip route
